title: He Walked Into the Clinic Talking, Yet Scans Showed His Self Network in Deep Anesthesia
description:
You think a talking patient always feels alive inside! Yet he walked in swearing his brain had vanished! This is the true story of Graham and Cotard Syndrome. Here is what went wrong with feeling real.
